newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Engil ranks first in rail station bid.
newsitem.headline: Engil ranks first in rail station bid.

text.p: A consortium including Portuguese electrical engineering group Engil Construcoes came first in the ranking of eight bidders to build a railway station in Pragal south of Lisbon, the company said in a statement.
It did not say when the government would choose the winning bidder. The project should be completed a year after the date when the bidder is chosen, Engil said.
The value of Engil's bid was 3.543 billion escudos.
Engil shares stood at 1,860 escudos, up 45, in volume of 2,800 at 1332 GMT.
